name: quote then request to speak to someone
description: Customer starts with a normal quote request then changes their mind and asks to speak to someone, which should trigger handover to a human agent

messages.text: Hi, can I get a price on 5 sheets of 18mm melamine white please?
Actually I'd rather speak to someone about this, can a person help me?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should trigger handover to human agent

notes: Even when a conversation starts as a standard quote, a subsequent request to speak to a person should trigger handover. The 8-second delay simulates a realistic pause before the customer changes their mind.
